race.comment: I'LBERIDIN'SHOTGUN (4) has been knocking on the door of late, narrowly beaten in two races prior to last start at Mildura which was on a good 4 track. His form prior on rain-affected ground reads well which he'll certainly get here, look for him to bounce back. BIG VEE (2) resumes. He's off a long spell having struggled in two runs last time in but he's won a jumpout leading in here and should be a sharp improver for the Meech/Dabernig combination. MISTER SOLLY (5) has placed in his past two, behind two handy ones last time at Hamilton. That form should hold up later in the card and he'll take plenty of catching. STAR ROTATION (8) ran well fresh here over 1000m and should come on from that, look for him late. PRINCE PRESTIGIOUS (7) perhaps next best.
